group.name: MUNISENSE
group.description: Munisense provides a managed infrastructure for wireless sensing and actuation. Munisense makes use of international standards and the safety and reliability of proven internet technologies. Munisense makes it possible to integrate sensing rapidly in specific organisational settings. The managed infrastructure makes it possible for the customer to concentrate on improving quality, reducing cost ,and improving the environment through: Real-time insight in the state, location, and use of your assetts.
